name: shopify

verification.follow_up: Ratify and run the independent connector evidence contract.

report_profiles._api_notes: GET /admin/api/{version}/products.json?published_at_min=&published_at_max=&limit=250 (Link rel=next cursor pagination). published_at = event_date (YYYY-MM-DD); title = label. A null published_at (unpublished product) emits no event. Reuses the existing shopify OAuth token/scope. Persisted to context_events (no fact_daily_kpi). AI-53: endpoint/field names declared from the Admin REST docs, to confirm on the live pass (no test account 2026-07-21).

_ai_53_notes.quota: AI-53 A CONFIRMER EN STORY: Shopify applique des call limits PAR PLAN MARCHAND (leaky bucket REST: 2 req/s standard, 4 req/s Shopify Plus, bucket 40/80). review-15-4 F-3: l'engine core est un FIXED-WINDOW (recharge complete par fenetre) et ne modelise PAS le leaky bucket -- une fenetre 60s/40pts autoriserait un BURST de 40 requetes instantanees (plus permissif que Shopify, pas 'prudent'). Profil retenu: window 1s / 2 points = 2 req/s soutenu SANS burst (approximation conservatrice du bucket standard). Le vrai backstop reste le handler 429 -> RateLimitError. A recalibrer via X-Shopify-Shop-Api-Call-Limit en passe live (Phase B).
_ai_53_notes.canonical_metric_mapping: AI-53 A CONFIRMER EN STORY: noms de champs API Admin REST supposes d'apres la doc: order.total_price -> revenue (montant total commande, additif), order.total_refunded (ou somme des refund.transactions) -> refund_amount (COLONNE DEDIEE, JAMAIS soustrait silencieusement de revenue), comptage d'ordres -> orders_count. A verifier endpoint/champs exacts (Admin REST vs GraphQL) en passe live (AI-53/AI-13).
_ai_53_notes.transaction_id: AI-53 A CONFIRMER EN STORY: transaction_id expose comme DIMENSION DE DETAIL du raw (une commande -> une/plusieurs transactions de paiement Shopify). C'est la cle de jointure GA4 x Shopify (Epic 17). Le mart agrege au JOUR: transaction_id N'est PAS une partition de breakdown du mart. Disponibilite exacte (order.transactions[].id vs order.id) a confirmer via la doc Admin API.
_ai_53_notes.refunds_decision: DECISION 15.4 (REFERENCE pour Stripe 15.7): les remboursements sont stockes en COLONNE DEDIEE refund_amount (metrique additive positive), JAMAIS soustraits silencieusement de revenue. Le net se calcule au niveau semantique (revenue - refund_amount) de facon explicite et auditable.

_error_map_note: Reference: Shopify Admin API 'Response codes' + 'Uninstalling an app' (shopify.dev/docs/api/admin). Shopify emits NO numeric error code: its whole error vocabulary is the body's 'errors' value, {"errors": "<verbatim message>"} (a string on the auth/lookup failures; an object of field messages on a 422 write, which this read-only connector never provokes). KEYS ARE THEREFORE THE VERBATIM DOCUMENTED MESSAGES. PAYLOAD SHAPE: core.pull_errors._extract_provider_codes has no 'errors' string branch, so connector._shopify_error_payload() copies that string into the top-level 'reason' slot -- the first top-level shape core consults -- while preserving every original key as evidence (the stripe/square normalisation pattern; core keeps zero provider vocabulary, AD-2). WHAT THE KEYS BUY: the 401 message is the ONE Shopify returns when the app has been uninstalled or the offline token revoked, and uninstalling invalidates the token immediately with no grace period -- so it is auth_revoked, not auth_expired: the merchant must reinstall/reauthorise the app, and no refresh will ever succeed. '404:Not Found' becomes invalid_request where core leaves 404 'unclassified', i.e. retried to the dead letter for a resource that no longer exists. STATUSES LEFT TO PURE HTTP ON PURPOSE: 402 (shop suspended) and 423 (shop locked) carry no stable documented message string to key on, and 403 (missing scope) is already permission_denied from the status alone. 429 (leaky-bucket overflow) keeps raising core.quota.RateLimitError (Story 3.3 breaker contract) and is never keyed here.
_account_topology_note: Shopify is shop-scoped: one OAuth token = one merchant store. There is no account hierarchy to discover or select; the shop_domain is the sole scope and is resolved from the connection's Nango credential at pull time. account_topology is therefore absent from this manifest by design, not by omission.

fields.description: Date a product was published to the Online Store (product.published_at from the Admin REST products edge). Maps to canonical event_type product_launch. label = product.title. A product with a null published_at (never published) emits no launch event. Persisted as a context_events pulse (value null).

_max_provider_backfill_days_note: No max_provider_backfill_days is declared because Shopify's 60-day limit on the Order resource is a SCOPE gate, not a window: an app granted read_all_orders reaches the full history (https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-rest/latest/resources/order). The reachable history therefore depends on the installation, which a manifest cannot state. Declaring a guessed window would promise a history the provider never committed to, so this module answers 'unknown' rather than a number (test_backfill_bound_is_declared_or_its_absence_is).
